brief: ASYMPTOTICS OF CHARACTERS OF SYMMETRIC GROUPS: STRUCTURE OF KEROV CHARACTER POLYNOMIALS — We study asymptotics of characters of the symmetric groups on a ﬁxed conjugacy class.
extended:
**ASYMPTOTICS OF CHARACTERS OF SYMMETRIC GROUPS: STRUCTURE OF KEROV CHARACTER POLYNOMIALS**

*MACIEJ DOŁ ˛EGA AND PIOTR ŚNIADY*

26 pp, 26 sections.

**Abstract.** We study asymptotics of characters of the symmetric groups on a ﬁxed conjugacy class. It was proved by Kerov that such a character can be expressed as a polynomial in free cumulants of the Young dia- gram (certain functionals describing the shape of the Young diagram). We show that for each genus there exists a universal symmetric polyno- mial which gives the coefﬁcients of the part of Kerov character polyno- mials with the prescribed homogeneous degree. The existence of such symmetric polynomials was conjectured by Lassalle.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 1.1 Asymptotic representation theory of symmet; 1.2 Asymptotic shape of Young diagrams; 1.3 How to normalize the characters?; 1.4 How to describe the shape of a Young diagr; 1.5 Free cumulants; 1.6 Kerov character polynomials; 1.7 Genus expansion; 1.8 The main result: proof of some conjectures; 1.9 General idea of the proof; 2 Goulden-Rattan formula and existence of symm; 2.1 Power series P; 2.2 Polynomial structure of coefficients of P; 2.3 Goulden-Rattan formula; 2.4 Proof of Proposition ??; 3 Divisibility of polynomials; 3.1 Implications of divisibility
